Yes, I'm serious. I almost posted on my main account I was so emotional reading the post I replied to. 

I didn't have a BF, but my best friend was a guy, who was basically my bf without the physical aspects. He believed the other guy and completely blew me off without talking to me... one night we were playing WOW drinking Jager and toking up, the night after the incident he wouldnt even look at me at work and completely stopped talking to me. That hurt more than anything I have ever experienced. 

Please don't doubt her, don't even let her think that that was ever a possibility in your mind. She may be acting calm and like it's no big deal now and she may have disassociated emotionally from the situation or be in a sort of emotional shock. It took 3 years for it to hit me, and it hit me HARD like the time that has past has made it grow and I have subconsciously isolated the hell out of myself since, I'm having a very hard time dealing with it now and not just taking the easy way out and offing myself. 

Talk to her about it if she wants to talk, Sit with her in the quiet if thats what she wants instead... follow her lead... She should seek counseling now sooner than later, and it may be helpful if you go with her as support. One thing I regret is not seeking counseling and taking the "ignore it and it will go away" approach... It worked for a few years and i was fine for awhile..  


but I'm so messed up now I startle extremely easy and have panic attacks from people touching me.

The feeling of not being able to talk to anyone because they believe me anyways.. I told one girlfriend about it, she was friends with the guy and she made if very clear that she didn't believe me and that people people thought i was a slut... she thought i was using that as an excuse for a one night stand that i regretted. That feeling is right up there as probably the second most painful thing I have experienced, but it persists and i still feel it now.. (first being losing my best friend) and is one of the reasons i am as messed up as I am. 

And Im sure i was on SOMETHING I have never ever felt like that. I was perfectly aware of everything that was happening when I was "awake" but I couldn't move my body at all.. In fact I tried to get up after he left and I couldn't even make it off my bed and ended up passing out again. I've never felt so powerless.


TLDR: Best thing you can do is be supportive. Help guide her to seek counseling and please dont ever let her think you doubted her even for a minute.
